Game Overview

Aces of the Luftwaffe Squadron puts players into a adventure experience centered on fly into high-octane aerial combat in Aces of the Luftwaffe Squadron, where WWII-era planes take on extraterrestrial foes. Evade swarms of alien ships, upgrade your arsenal, and utilize unique pilots' abilities. Personalize your strategy for intense 2D arcade action, and turn the tide of galactic war.
